description: Calculates customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), the LTV to CAC ratio and CAC payback in months from spend, new customers, revenue per customer, gross margin and churn.

acquisition_spend.description: Total sales and marketing spend for the period, in currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross margin as a percentage, for example 70.

monthly_churn_pct.description: Share of customers lost per month as a percentage, for example 3.

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Average revenue per customer per month (ARPU), in currency units.

new_customers.description: New paying customers acquired in the same period.

name: unit_economics
title: Unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback)
